plan.title: SRC-AWD-005 — Award all units to L1 vendor

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with two bids directly on Master QCS.
Enable the eRFX project capability required by the case.
Confirm both bidding vendors are present as real vendor columns.
Verify Vendor B is the L1-ranked bidder.
Verify Vendor B's bid rate is 90 per unit.
Open the awarding screen to allocate the line quantity.
Allocate all 10 requested units to the L1 vendor, Vendor B.
Verify one line is fully selected, only one of two vendors is awarded, and the proposal total is 900.
Open the proposal page from the completed allocation.

args.goal: fill the required proposal fields for Vendor B's 10-unit award and submit the proposal; stop when the proposal is shown as submitted

steps.note: The catalog has no dedicated step for completing and submitting the required proposal fields.
Confirm the award proposal was submitted successfully.
Complete the post-award flow and create the purchase order.
Verify the resulting PO contains exactly one awarded line with quantity 10.
